timing: Selection before any new evaluation session; all promoted content is copied unchanged.

rationale.1: Promote: original training shows relative Read paths failing and absolute paths succeeding; reusable environment advice.
rationale.2: Reject: blanket avoidance of automated parsing or OCR is not justified by one successful manual extraction; this task includes image-only content.
rationale.3: Reject: always embedding complete data instead of dynamic parsing/transformation is an unjustified general rule and does not improve scalability.
rationale.4: Promote: exact decimal arithmetic is appropriate for fractional prices, signed credits and monetary reconciliation. The wording about floats masking 0.01 is broader than demonstrated; content is preserved unchanged.

limits: Human-reviewed candidates are not independently validated by learning. These two procedural themes also appeared in earlier fast-consistency advice; this is a new standard-generation run, not a distinct-task benchmark.
